targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:deploy AND status:success | stats count() deploys

panels.title: Deploy frequency (successful deploys)
panels.description: This panel shows the number of successful deployments in the specified time period. A higher number indicates more frequent deployments, reflecting a faster release cycle.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:deploy AND status:failure | stats count() failures

panels.title: Change failures (failed deploys)
panels.description: Shows the number of failed deployments in the system. A higher number indicates more deployment failures, which may suggest instability or issues in the CI/CD process.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run AND status:failure | stats count() failures

panels.title: CI failures
panels.description: Shows the total number of failed CI runs. A higher number indicates more frequent failures in the CI process.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run AND attempt:>1 | stats count() flaky

panels.title: Flaky CI runs (attempt > 1)
panels.description: Shows the number of CI runs that required more than one attempt to succeed. A higher number indicates more unreliable CI runs.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run | stats avg(queue_ms) queue_ms

panels.title: Avg CI queue time
panels.description: Shows the average time in milliseconds that a CI job spends waiting in the queue before starting. A higher value indicates longer wait times, which may suggest congestion or limited CI resources.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run AND status:success | stats avg(duration_ms) duration_ms

panels.title: Avg CI duration (success)
panels.description: Shows the average time in milliseconds for successful CI runs. A higher value means CI builds are taking longer on average.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:deploy AND status:success | stats avg(duration_ms) duration_ms

panels.title: Avg deploy duration (success)
panels.description: Shows the average time in milliseconds it takes to complete a successful deployment. A higher value means deployments are taking longer on average, while a lower value indicates faster successful deployments.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:(drift OR drill) AND status:failure | stats count() failures

panels.title: Drift / drill failures
panels.description: Shows the total number of failed drift or drill events. A higher number indicates more frequent failures in system configuration or testing processes.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:deploy | stats by (status) count() deploys

panels.title: Deploys by status over time
panels.description: Shows the number of deployments over time, grouped by their status. A rising number of failed or canceled deployments indicates potential issues in the deployment process.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run | stats by (status) count() runs

panels.title: CI runs by status over time
panels.description: Shows the number of CI runs over time, grouped by their status. An increasing number of runs indicates higher activity, while a rise in failed or canceled runs may signal issues in the CI process.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:ci_run | stats by (workflow, status) count() n | sort by (n) desc

panels.title: CI runs by workflow × status
panels.description: Shows the number of CI runs grouped by workflow and status, with counts in raw numbers. A high count for a specific workflow-status combination indicates frequent execution or potential bottlenecks in that workflow.

targets.expr: schema:"ops_event/v1" AND event_type:(drift OR drill) | stats by (event_type, workflow, status) count() n | sort by (n) desc

panels.title: Drift / drill outcomes
panels.description: Shows the number of drift and drill events grouped by type, workflow, and status. A high count indicates frequent incidents or tests, while changes over time may reflect shifts in system stability or testing activity.

panels.title: Recent failures — tail (deploy / ci / drift / drill)
panels.description: The most recent failed deploy, CI, drift and drill events, one log line each, newest first. Use it to see which run failed and when.
